title: Add package release and consumer sync automation
context: Automatically bump consumers when a package publishes a new version.

spec.summary: Add package release and consumer sync automation
spec.expected_outcome: Confirm the migrated scope and acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: A new `typescript-dom` release opens bumps for browser consumers.
A new `python-etl-contracts` release opens bumps for dashboards.
A new `game-kit` release opens bumps for games.
A new `go-cli` image release updates the pinned image reference.
PRs are authored by `gardusi-gustavo-bot` and reviewed/merged by `gardusi-gustavo`.
Re-running the sync does not duplicate open PRs.
Consumers with local path dependencies fail the check.
The job reports missing consumers and version drift.
The mechanism is documented: Renovate or custom `pkg sync`.
Choose Renovate self-hosted vs custom `pkg sync`.
Add the package matrix.
Add the Gitea token for consumer PRs.
Add the schedule or release trigger.
Test with one npm, one PyPI, and one Cargo consumer.
Add grouping and duplicate detection.
Link the version policy.
A dry run lists the consumer PRs without writing.
A real run opens exactly one PR per consumer update.
CI passes in the consumer PRs.
The matrix covers every publisher and consumer.
